name: Nijiiro no Ikikata
source:
One day after school, I (Iwashimizu Chiho) was confessed to byAkiramura Naoko. I have always liked Akimura-san, and we started dating.

But my father has a prejudice against homosexuality.
There are also prejudices at school.
And some politicians discriminate against homosexuals.

We decided to tell people with such prejudice about homosexuality in our own way ...
translation:
某天放学后，我——岩清水千穗，收到了明村尚子的告白。我也一直喜欢着明村同学，于是，我们开始交往。

可是，父亲对同性恋抱有偏见。
学校里也有人抱有偏见。
还有一些政客歧视同性恋者。

我们决定用自己的方式，向这些心存偏见的人传达关于同性恋的事情……
